text:
elaine: Quick sync  launch post ops pack needed: focused KW list, JSON-LD for webinar + benchmark pages, internal-link map (seed -> clusters), and redirect rules for legacy blog slugs. Lock by EOD Wed.
marco: I'll take keywords + anchor CSV. Targeting feature queries, benchmark comparisons, and integration how-tos (12-15 targets).
jamal: I'll draft minimal JSON-LD for Event (webinar) and Article (benchmark). Example Event to paste in <head>: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Launch Webinar","startDate":"2026-04-14T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar"}}
```
sophia: Redirect inventory exported (pre-2024 /blog/*) to the shared sheet. Proposal: 302 test window 7-14d -> convert to 301 after QA. Will request infra window 02:00-04:00 UTC.
elaine: Add an "anchor_rewrite" column that maps CTAs to /webinar (primary) and /demo-request (secondary). Keep top-funnel posts to one CTA.
seo-bot: crawl-scan: benchmark-drafts -> 6 images missing alt text, 2 broken internal links (rows flagged).
marco: will fix alt tags and broken anchors. Internal linking plan (seed -> clusters): benchmark, integration, pricing, migration, case study. Anchor examples: "benchmark results", "how to integrate", "cost vs performance". Limit 2 contextual links per cluster. I'll drop CSV with columns: source_url,target_url,anchor_text,reason.
jamal: QA note: include Article.mainEntityOfPage and image object in Article JSON-LD for richer results. Validate with Rich Results Test + Lighthouse after push; I'll run a smoke pass.
sophia: Draft nginx redirect examples in sheet comments: ```nginx
# temp 302
rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /new-blog/$1 redirect;
# promote to 301 after test window
rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /new-blog/$1 permanent;
```
elaine: Final checklist by EOD Wed:
- marco: KW list + anchor CSV in drive
- jamal: schema snippets + validation notes
- sophia: redirect sheet + infra ticket + rollout window
- elaine: copy QA + CTA placement (primary CTA = webinar sign-up)
marco: ack :thumbsup:
sophia: ack, will ping infra after sheet signoff
jamal: ack, will queue validation once JSON-LD is live
elaine: keep promo CTAs focused (one primary CTA). We'll iterate CTA language after the first benchmark week. :rocket:
